rules: Discover broadly. Organize by desired outcome. Execute through campaigns.
An opportunity is an instrument inside a plan, not the plan itself.
Priority controls sequence, not census inclusion.
Every route must state which terminal campaign it advances and which evidence family it consumes.
Support campaigns exist to manufacture stronger evidence for the terminal Main Quest campaigns.

terminal_campaigns.title: Funded PhD Option Creation
terminal_campaigns.objective: Create multiple genuinely funded doctoral options, then compare real admissions and funding packages rather than pre-committing to one institution.
terminal_campaigns.input_universe: 61 Taiwan PhD routes from Pass 2 census
terminal_campaigns.success_state: At least two serious funded doctoral options or a source-verified explanation of why the census could not produce them.

terminal_campaigns.title: Employment Option Creation
terminal_campaigns.objective: Create serious offers across distinct labor-market families and learn what the market will pay for the combined finance, research and AI-systems profile.
terminal_campaigns.input_universe: 88 Taiwan employment routes from Pass 2 census plus explicit employer delta-search debt
terminal_campaigns.success_state: Multiple interview or offer signals across at least two role families, or a source-verified explanation of the market gates encountered.

support_campaigns.title: Academic Evidence Factory
support_campaigns.objective: Convert research assets into stronger Main Quest evidence rather than generating conference activity for its own sake.

assets.current_hard_gate: sample/perimeter authority before downstream venue activity

assets.conversion_goal: replication and empirical upgrade → publication candidate
credible identification and data completion → working paper

support_campaigns.title: Systems Evidence Factory
support_campaigns.objective: Turn working systems into inspectable, externally credible evidence that strengthens PhD and employment packets.

assets.main_quest_job: general AI systems / reliability / research-software identity
research tooling, data and research-engineering proof

support_campaigns.title: Economics and Runway
support_campaigns.objective: Resolve current cash economics for every route before using economics to rank outcomes.

shared_infrastructure.purpose: One source-of-truth profile from which PhD and employment packet families are derived.
Maps every claim in CV/SOP/resume/project sheets to inspectable proof and current project revision.
Reusable recommender brief, research summary, deadlines and route-specific emphasis for doctoral applications.
Only the differences from the shared packet: faculty, research question, role-specific evidence, required forms and declarations.
Compare actual admissions/offers using funding/salary, certainty, research value, credential conversion, location and option value.

execution_principle: Build shared assets first when one artifact unlocks many routes; then spend route-specific effort only on irreducible deltas.
